messages:
maria g: Nightly eval flagged redwood-open-7b-quant — large QA/EM drop (~12%) vs baseline after last runtime deploy. Failing prompt examples inline. @cheng z @alex l @sam p please triage.

eval-bot: Nightly run summary: model=redwood-open-7b-quant, cohort=qa_prompts_v3, metric=exact_match, baseline=0.78, current=0.66, delta=-0.12. Full report: https://ci.internal/evals/runs/1782345600 (summary attached).

cheng z: Ack. Any idea which deploy touched the inference path? RNG/attention changes can cause diffs.

alex l: I merged runtime PR #342 yesterday evening (commit a1b2c3d). It reorders KV writes to reduce memcopies on long sequences, no intentional RNG change. Rolling back would be quick if that looks suspicious.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed runtime@a1b2c3d -> us-west-1 at 2026-03-18T22:10:12Z. Canary traffic=5%.

sam p: I ran a local reproducer against a1b2c3d and previous commit (96f7e2a). Quick diff: generated text shows repetition and occasional token shifts in answers. Repro command: ```./tools/run_infer.sh --model redwood-open-7b-quant --seed 42 --prompt-file tests/qa_sample_10.txt --commit a1b2c3d``` Output excerpt: "Answer: 42 42 42" where baseline is single "42".

cheng z: That pattern smells like KV cache indexing mismatch — reordering could shift which past key/values align to current positions, causing attention to attend to wrong tokens, especially in quantized kernels where offsets are tighter.

maria g: Failing prompt (one of many): "Q: What is the capital of X?" Baseline: "A: Y." Current: "A: Y. Y. Y." Also some answers wrong on math prompts. Logs show attn_mask indices off by 1 around step 8.

alex l: I can open revert PR for the reorder and run canary rollback. Also will add a unit test that compares KV indices between commits for short and long seqs. Pushing PR now.

alex l: PR #349 opened: revert runtime reorder (diff attached). Triggering canary rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollback started: runtime@96f7e2a -> canary at 2026-03-18T22:35:01Z.

eval-bot: Triggered ad-hoc eval on rollback candidate. Running subset: qa_prompts_v3 (10k examples). Will post deltas when done.

sam p: Re-ran local reproducer against 96f7e2a -> repetition gone, outputs match baseline for sampled prompts. Looks promising.

eval-bot: Ad-hoc results: exact_match baseline=0.78, rollback=0.79, current(a1b2c3d)=0.66. Regression reproducible on quantized builds; fp16 path shows ~0.02 drop only.

maria g: Good catch. Hold any further rollouts of a1b2c3d until we patch the reorder with KV-index invariant checks. This impacted quantized path much worse.

cheng z: Action items: (1) alex to add KV alignment unit tests + repro; (2) infra to block canary promotion for a1b2c3d; (3) deep-dive why quantized kernels amplify misalignment. I'll take (3).

alex l: Working on tests now. I'll also add an assert in debug builds to verify KV index monotonicity. ETA couple hours.

maria g: Thanks. filing incident ticket so support/product can be notified. cc: @sam p for evaluation regression tracking. :exclamation:

eval-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-032 — nightly-quality-regression. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-032

sam p: Noting for onboarding checklist: add quantized-run smoke to post-deploy checks. This would've tripped in pre-prod.

maria g: Agreed. Let's keep this thread for follow-ups.
